# Generated by Devex. Unmodified generated versions are updated automatically.
# Custom changes are preserved. The machine-specific engine path stays in .devex/.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.devex/code/DevexProject.cmake" OPTIONAL)
project(Game LANGUAGES CXX)

find_package(Devex CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

file(GLOB_RECURSE sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cxx" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.hpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.hh"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.hxx" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.inl")
# IDE outputs and compiler probes are not game sources, even when the IDE builds in code/.
list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "(^|/)([.][^/]+|[Bb][Ii][Nn]|[Oo][Bb][Jj]|[Bb][Uu][Ii][Ll][Dd]|[Oo][Uu][Tt]|CMakeFiles|cmake-build[^/]*)(/|$)")
devex_add_game_module(SOURCES ${sources})
